items.title: Oracle cancels $7 bln chip leasing deal with Tencent, FT reports
items.summary: Investing.com-- Oracle has scuttled a $7 billion chip leasing contract with Tencent amid increased pressure from the Trump administration, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday.

items.title: Nvidia China clients to get 1% of $70 bln RTX chips ordered- Bloomberg
items.summary: Investing.com -- Chinese artificial intelligence developers expect to receive just a fraction of the advanced chips ordered from NVIDIA Corp (NASDAQ:NVDA) over the coming months, Bloomberg reported on Wednesday.
